label: Senior Full-Stack Developer
positioning: Hands-on senior individual contributor who delivers end-to-end web products with strong React expertise, Node.js APIs, data stores, cloud services, and deployment automation.
summaryInstructions: Lead with 8+ years of production web development across healthcare and e-commerce.
Emphasize React, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, and CI/CD only when matched to the job.
Use healthcare interoperability as a differentiator, not as a requirement for every full-stack role.
Do not imply people management from the Shift title.
Prefer end-to-end feature ownership language over broad architecture claims.

coverLetterStrategy.opening: Connect the role's product and technical needs to Fred's end-to-end delivery experience.
avoid: Leadership claims not supported by actual responsibilities
FHIR detail when the employer is not in healthcare

resumeRules.includeProjectsWhen: Include one or two projects when they provide evidence missing from professional experience.
